values.description: Cloudability API base URL. Do not change unless directed by IBM support.
Frontdoor Public Key. Used only in the 001 Authentication flow to obtain an OpenToken via the Frontdoor API.

Your Cloudability API key (OpenToken). Retrieve from: Cloudability UI > Settings > API Access, or obtain via the Frontdoor Auth flow in section 000 Authentication. Treat as a secret -- do not commit to source control.
Opentoken expiration
The customer name in Frontdoor
Name of the Apptio Environment that contains the CLDY instance
Your Cloudability Environment ID (org ID). Retrieve using the 'Get Environment ID' call in section 000 Authentication. Example value: 123456
Set to true to use a Cloudability Legacy API key
This is the Cloudability API key for use as an alternative authentication method (instead of an Apptio Opentoken)
The Cloudability Organization ID

A Cloudability View ID. Default value '0' means all data (admin only -- bypasses all View filters). Retrieve specific View IDs using the 'Get Views' call in section 400. Used throughout Cost Reporting, Rightsizing, Budgets, and Forecast calls.
A Business Mapping (Business Dimension) ID. Used in section 100 calls that require an ID path parameter. Retrieve from the 'Retrieve Business Mappings' response -- copy the integer 'id' field.
A Business Metric ID. Used in section 150 calls that require an ID path parameter. Retrieve from the 'Retrieve Business Metrics' response -- copy the integer 'id' field.
An Account Group ID. Used in section 200 (201 Account Group calls). Retrieve from the 'Get Account Groups' response.
An Account Group Entry ID. Used in section 202 calls that require an entry ID path parameter. Retrieve from the 'Account Group Entries' response for a specific group.
A Cloudability integer user ID. Used in section 300 Update User and Delete User calls. Retrieve from the 'Get Users' response -- copy the integer 'id' field.
A Budget UUID. Used in section 601 calls that require a budget ID. Retrieve from the 'Get Budget' response. Format example: d090e29e-2a26-4ca5-7f9a-67be3134081e
A Budget Subscription UUID. Used in section 602 Update and Delete Subscription calls. Retrieve from the 'Get All Subscriptions' response.

An enqueue job ID. Returned by the 'Run Report as Enqueue' call (POST /enqueue). Used in 'Check Enqueue Job Status' and 'Enqueue Results from ID'. Capture from the result.id field of the POST response.
An AWS account number (12-digit string). Used as a vendorAccountId value in section 051 credentialing calls and as a filter value in rightsizing and cost reporting calls. Example: 123456789012
An Azure Subscription ID (UUID format). Used as vendorAccountId in section 052 credentialing and as a filter in rightsizing calls. Example: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
A GCP Project ID string. Used as vendorAccountId in section 053 GCP credentialing and as a filter in GCP rightsizing calls. Example: my-gcp-project-id
A GCP Billing Account ID (format: XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX). Used in the 'Create GCP Account Credential' call body as vendorAccountId. Example: 01A1DD-D1F1E1-F11111
A tag dimension key for use in rightsizing filters (e.g., tag3 for the 'Environment' tag). Find the correct index using Get Cost Measures in section 700.
A tag value for use in rightsizing filters (e.g., 'Production'). Used with rsTagKey to filter rightsizing results to a specific environment or team.
A specific resource identifier for filtering rightsizing results to a single resource (e.g., AWS EC2 instance ID 'i-1234567890abcdef0', GCP disk name, Azure VM resource ID).
A cloud region for filtering rightsizing results. Use AWS format (us-east-1), Azure format (eastus), or GCP format (us-central1) depending on the endpoint.
Minimum monthly savings threshold for filtering rightsizing recommendations (dollar amount). Use with a filter like: filters=recommendations.savings>{{rsMinSavings}}
